name: decision_log_search_decisions
description: Search decisions in the authenticated workspace.

name: decision_log_get_decision
description: Retrieve one decision by ID.

name: decision_log_supersede_decision
description: Create a replacement Decision and supersession relationship for an existing Decision.

name: decision_log_lock_decision
description: Irreversibly prevent a current Decision from ever being superseded; may create an approval request.

name: decision_log_approve_decision_action
description: Record one immutable approval or rejection attestation.

name: decision_log_get_decision_governance
description: Retrieve lock, authority snapshot, and approval state for a Decision.

name: decision_log_list_recent_decisions
description: List the most recent decisions in the authenticated workspace.

name: decision_log_submit_source
description: Submit source content for ingestion and later provenance links.

name: decision_log_list_sources
description: List visible SourceContent using bounded excerpts and canonical retention redaction.

name: decision_log_get_source
description: Retrieve one visible SourceContent detail projection. Redacted, purged, and unknown retention states never return stored title, content, blob URL, or metadata.

name: decision_log_get_source_decisions
description: Retrieve visible DecisionSource links for one SourceContent record with each linked Decision's lifecycle, authoritative current-state, and supersession identity.

name: decision_log_list_candidates
description: List reviewable DecisionCandidates visible in the current Organization and Workspace before taking a resolution action.

name: decision_log_get_candidate
description: Get the complete visible review context for one DecisionCandidate before approving, rejecting, or converting it.

name: decision_log_create_candidate
description: Create a reviewable DecisionCandidate.

name: decision_log_resolve_candidate
description: Approve or reject a pending DecisionCandidate.

name: decision_log_convert_candidate_to_supersession
description: Approve a pending DecisionCandidate as the immutable replacement for one current Decision, preserving provenance and supersession history.

name: decision_log_get_current_decision
description: Get the newest active decision in a domain.

name: decision_log_get_supersession_history
description: Retrieve the complete visible Decision supersession chain in oldest-to-newest order. Malformed chains fail closed and never claim a current Decision.

name: decision_log_get_decision_sources
description: Retrieve retention-safe provenance links for one visible Decision, including relationship, source lifecycle, and submitter metadata.

name: decision_log_list_audit_events
description: List the visible append-only audit events for the current Organization using the canonical permission-aware, attribution-safe projection.

name: decision_log_list_decisions_by_tag
description: List decisions related to an exact tag slug.

name: decision_log_list_decisions_by_domain
description: List decisions related to an exact domain slug.

name: decision_log_render_decision
description: Use this when the user wants to inspect one known Decision in a visual card. Call a data retrieval tool first when the Decision ID is unknown.

name: decision_log_render_workspace_brief
description: Use this when the user wants a visual briefing of recent decisions, pending candidates, and source activity.

name: decision_log_render_decision_explorer
description: Use this when the user wants to browse the five most recent Decisions and optionally inspect one in detail.

name: decision_log_render_candidate_review
description: Use this when the user wants to inspect and disposition one known DecisionCandidate in a visual review workbench.

name: decision_log_render_supersession_composer
description: Use this when the user has a known active Decision and complete replacement meaning to review before supersession.

name: decision_log_render_source_pipeline
description: Use this when the user wants to inspect one known source, its provenance lifecycle, and extracted candidates.

name: decision_log_render_audit_explorer
description: Use this when the user wants to visually inspect attributable, append-only audit events with filtering and pagination.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: decision_log_get_source, decision_log_get_candidate · Private data: decision_log_approve_decision_action, decision_log_get_source_decisions · Public sink: decision_log_submit_source.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: decision_log_get_source, decision_log_get_candidate · Private data: decision_log_approve_decision_action, decision_log_get_source_decisions · Public sink: decision_log_submit_source

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
